svg.title: AGENT / SWARM · demonstration activity calendar
svg.desc: GitHub-style calendar of observed source events, with a deterministic swarm of geometric helpers ferrying symbolic work to recorded event dates. This does not represent the complete GitHub contribution graph or autonomous GitHub actions.
svg.text: SOURCE-OBSERVED EVENTS · THE AGENTS ARE A VISUAL METAPHOR
